science: Both controls use the full finite-prestrain W_FF bulk operator and static normal balance. A constant pressure per current area supplies varying nominal traction when the surface moves; its work follows from p detF. The determinant is a bulk null Lagrangian, so only natural boundary traction changes. Source instead imposes dead nominal traction. Oracle modifies the two boundary rows; reference differentiates original scalar energy and solves a depth finite-element generalized eigenproblem.
